KPI Card

KPI Cards display key performance indicators with values, trends, icons, sparklines, comparisons, and progress toward goals. Use them in dashboard grids for at-a-glance metrics.

Basic KPI Card

Value, label, and trend percentage.

Total Revenue

↑ 12.5% vs last month
Active Users

↑ 8.2% vs last month
Conversion Rate
3.24%
↓ 1.3% vs last month
Avg. Session
4m 32s
— No change
HTML
<div class="zak-card">
  <div class="zak-card-body">
    <div style="font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted); margin-bottom: 0.25rem;">Total Revenue</div>
    <div style="font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700;">$48,290</div>
    <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--zak-success, #10b981); margin-top: 0.25rem;">&uarr; 12.5% vs last month</div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="zak-card">
  <div class="zak-card-body" style="display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem;">
    <div style="width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: var(--zak-radius-md); background: var(--zak-primary-bg, #eff6ff); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;">
      <svg class="zak-icon" style="color: var(--zak-primary);" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 2v20M17 5H9.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7H6"/></svg>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div style="font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted);">Revenue</div>
      <div style="font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700;">$48,290</div>
      <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--zak-success, #10b981);">&uarr; 12.5%</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

HTML
<div class="zak-card">
  <div class="zak-card-body">
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start;">
      <div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted);">Page Views</div>
        <div style="font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700;">124,563</div>
      </div>
      <svg width="100" height="40" viewBox="0 0 100 40">
        <polyline points="0,32 14,26 28,30 42,18 56,22 70,12 84,16 100,8" fill="none" stroke="var(--zak-primary)" stroke-width="2"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--zak-success, #10b981); margin-top: 0.5rem;">&uarr; 15.3% vs last week</div>
  </div>
</div>

KPI with Comparison

Compare current period vs previous period.

Revenue Comparison
This Month
$48,290
Last Month
$42,950
↑ $5,340 more than last month
HTML
<div class="zak-card">
  <div class="zak-card-body">
    <div style="font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted); margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Revenue Comparison</div>
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;">
      <div>
        <div style="font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted);">This Month</div>
        <div style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700;">$48,290</div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align: right;">
        <div style="font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted);">Last Month</div>
        <div style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--zak-text-muted);">$42,950</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style="height: 6px; background: var(--zak-border); border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden;">
      <div style="height: 100%; width: 89%; background: var(--zak-success, #10b981); border-radius: 9999px;"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

KPI with Progress Goal

Progress bar showing how close you are to a goal.

Monthly Sales Goal
847 of 1,000
84.7% complete 153 remaining
Support Tickets Resolved
312 of 350
89.1% complete 38 remaining
HTML
<div class="zak-card">
  <div class="zak-card-body">
    <div style="font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted); margin-bottom: 0.25rem;">Monthly Sales Goal</div>
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
      <span style="font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700;">847</span>
      <span style="font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted);">of 1,000</span>
    </div>
    <div style="height: 8px; background: var(--zak-border); border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden;">
      <div style="height: 100%; width: 84.7%; background: var(--zak-primary); border-radius: 9999px; transition: width 0.5s;"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted); margin-top: 0.375rem;">
      <span>84.7% complete</span>
      <span>153 remaining</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

ClassDescription
.zak-cardKPI card container
.zak-card-bodyCard content area with padding
.zak-text-successPositive trend indicator
.zak-text-dangerNegative trend indicator
